description: An import projecting the whole defaults namespace with one token gives the imported invocation every slot in it: the fragment's stamp reads locale en-gb, system metric, and units si — values reachable only through the projection — while its own format other binds as a first value under the reject default, proving the format slot outside the namespace was not projected; the entry's later stamp still reads format iso, and the import item carries project [defaults]. projection-stale.kdl is the pre-growth twin where the same import leaves units unset (invalid/data/import-namespace-projection-stale)
